title: Grow
prompt: Return the rectangle made bigger by margin on every side, so it stays centred where it was.
signature: func solve(r: Rect2, margin: float) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(r: Rect2, margin: float) -> Rect2:
	return r
hint: Rect2 has a grow method. Note the position moves up-left while the size grows by twice the margin.
solution:
func solve(r: Rect2, margin: float) -> Rect2:
	return r.grow(margin)
